description: Say that a unit you authored still holds after you ran it again, on the versions you name (requires auth, free): its "verified on" days move to today, a "re-check due" mark clears and it ranks as before. No new version and no validation — a change to the text is revise_knowledge. Use it after an upstream release when the unit still works — name the version you ran it on, or say it still holds on the old one; once a day per unit. A unit that names no versions yet needs verifiedAgainst.

id.description: the id of the unit's latest published version (my_listings gives it); you must be its author

verifiedAgainst.description: the products and versions you re-checked it on (they replace those products' entries); left out, the unit's list stays and every day moves to today

checkedAt.description: the day you checked it; left out, today

product.description: what it ran on: ecosystem:name for packages and repos (npm:@anthropic-ai/sdk, pypi:anthropic, github:actions/runner, mcp:io.github.x/y) or a plain name (postgres, macOS)

version.description: the version or range it held on: 16, 16.x, 0.40.2, >=1.4 <2

name: recheck_knowledge
title: Re-check your knowledge
